yardRules: Speed limit: 5 mph at all times
No passengers allowed on truck beds or on trailers
All passengers must exit the vehicle and stand in the designated area while being unloaded by mechanical equipment
Shirt and shoes must be worn at all times
Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult at all times
Valid state-issued photo ID required to be on file
Items must be sorted before going to small scales
Non-ferrous loads must be pre-sorted by customer before bringing in to scrap
Deductions will be made for dirt, tires, wood, concrete, etc. at the discretion of the yard supervisor
$100 minimum charge for sorting items with radiation (subject to rejection)
Wes' Recycling is not responsible for damage to vehicles, tires, or trailers
vehicleRequirements: Title required on all complete vehicles
Vehicles 35 years or older (1989 or older) can be brought in without title — a Bill of Sale will be filled out
Air conditioning units must be disconnected
Refrigerants must be removed from all vehicles and appliances
Up to 4 passenger tires per vehicle before deducting tire weight
Will NOT accept hybrid or electric vehicles unless ALL EV batteries have been removed
rvCamperGuidelines: Purchased at net ton price with NO deductions for debris
All RV/Campers inspected prior to purchase
Will NOT be accepted if excessive debris and/or trash is found in the unit
tankRules: Propane tanks, helium tanks, and fire extinguishers must have valve removed OR a hole big enough to see into the container
Tanks larger than 100 gallons must have a 3' x 3' hole
Fuel tanks must have an 8" x 8" hole and be dry
All tanks must be empty and dry

shortSteel.title: #2 Short Steel
shortSteel.specs: Maximum dimensions: 2' x 3' x 4'. Must be clean of concrete, wood, and other non-metallic attachments.

preparedSteel.title: P&S Prepared Steel
preparedSteel.specs: Maximum dimensions: 2' x 5'. Minimum 1/4" thick. Clean of concrete, wood, and other non-metallic attachments.

applianceRules: Appliances containing refrigerants must have NO FREON — seller responsible for proper removal prior to bringing to yard
Signed verification is required confirming refrigerant removal
safetyGuidelines: No passengers allowed in truck beds or on trailers
Children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult at all times
Shoes must be worn at all times
Exit your vehicle when it is being unloaded by mechanical equipment
Wes' Recycling is not responsible for damages to vehicles, tires, or trailers
Refrigerants must be removed from all vehicles and appliances — signed verification is required
Must be with parents or 18 years of age or older to sell steel
All scales tested & certified per local, state, & federal requirements
warningBanner: Refusal to follow regulations may result in refusal to do business with you.
